BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-Subbox
BundleInfo.Author: Mart So-Last
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Subbox particle STAR files from placed monomer maps
BundleInfo.Description:
Expand a subtomogram-averaging particle STAR file into sub-particles.
Place one or more copies of a monomer/reference map onto a parent complex map in the ChimeraX scene (e.g. one alpha/beta-tubulin monomer on each protofilament of a microtubule segment). Subbox reads each child map's orientation and box-centre offset relative to the parent, then rewrites every particle in the STAR file into one sub-particle per child, with the corresponding rotation and translation applied. Works with RELION (rln*) and Warp (wrp*) column conventions.
